title: The absolute value of an integer in [-9,9] is an integer in [0,9]

ground_truth.statement: The absolute value of an integer in [-9,9] is an integer in [0,9]. The bounded input avoids PHP_INT_MIN overflow to float.

notes: Clean-room semantic contract derived from the catalog lead, not a copy of its test harness. Runtime controls distinguish successful values from rejected or absent alternatives.
